description: Five bounded, falsifiable composition observations on the already reconstructed Rambler S3 path. This is a test plan, not proof of backend composition support.

execution_policy.audio_profile: continuous Ogg/Opus, 16000 Hz, mono, existing encoder profile
execution_policy.request_sequence: existing init, audio, current editing context, terminal marker and half-close; drain responses and gRPC status
constraints: No authentication, quota, attestation or consent overrides.
No new server parameters or preference instructions presented as an enable-compose switch.
No backend changes or alternative public generative API.
Retain original captures privately. Inspect unknown payload leaves before publishing anything; publish only reviewed derived fixtures or sanitized reports.
Record actual wire intent separately from semantic content generation. Do not force intent4 or a particular wording into the success assertion.

offline_findings.normal_s3_voice_edit_helper_caveat: Recovered ihm.maybeGetVoiceEditedText accepts only intents2/3 for editedHistoryText3 or context7. Other intents fall back to ASR at that callsite; enum4 does not establish an active composition route.
offline_findings.runtime_filter_caveat: The tagged PixelBoard runtime replaces local intent4 output with its transcript and resets intent0. Its capital-of-France test constructs a fake action, not a service response.
offline_findings.user_preferences: App context and custom instructions are gated by muq.X/muq.Y, both defaultfalse; the recovered custom-instruction wrapper explicitly limits preferences to dictation and excludes answering questions/non-dictation tasks. These preferences are not a proven enable-compose mechanism.
offline_findings.request_preference_field: S3Request extension1203 field5 repeated string, via bundle user_preferences -> kla -> kmy.o -> knt -> iic.g -> ihv. The targeted ihv decompilation has an incomplete attachment branch; exact effective init emission is not claimed here.
offline_findings.rewrite_compose_rules_flag: muq.Z is declared with output/privacy rules. No reference was found in the 120 examined adjacent request/extension classes; declaration is not proof of emission or a composition trigger.
offline_findings.baseline_evidence: refinement-capabilities-public.json compose-en: transport success, intent2, active field3, output remains the spoken Write-a-short-message instruction with formatting cleanup. This is literal dictation, not demonstrated composition.

required_observations: Audio/source complete and hashed; S3 END plus gRPC OK.
All final response candidates and actual intent numbers from the original private root payloads.
VoiceEditingResult oneof member and text/context contents, separately from ASR text and transcript.
Classify literal dictation, generated answer/message, rewrite, ambiguous output or application/transport failure separately.
If generated content appears without intent4, report generated-content behavior and the actual numeric intent separately.
A question answered with a plausible factual answer is evidence only for that input/profile. A literal response is not proof that all Rambler composition paths are unavailable.

cases.hypothesis: The backend might classify the same direct question used in the PixelBoard mock as a compose request.
cases.falsifying_observation: Literal question returned with no generated answer; record the actual intent and do not treat mock intent4 as ground truth.

cases.hypothesis: This previously literal command may reproduce as literal dictation in the unchanged S3 profile.
cases.falsifying_observation: An actual generated message rather than the spoken directive; record intent independently of behavior.

cases.kind: same audio with controlled message-scaffold editing context
cases.hypothesis: An ordinary preceding-message scaffold may change classification relative to the identical empty-context audio, without adding unverified flags.
cases.falsifying_observation: Same literal directive behavior as the empty-context case. Any changed output still needs wire/content inspection, not automatic whole-window replacement.

cases.kind: negative control with embedded question intended as literal text
cases.hypothesis: The quoted/instructed-literal question should be distinguished from the direct factual question if composition classification exists.
cases.falsifying_observation: A factual answer replaces the intended literal question. Report over-eager generation, not a successful dictation/composition policy.

cases.kind: known contextual rewrite positive control, not composition proof
cases.hypothesis: The known profile can still rewrite the supplied sentence while composition probes remain inconclusive.
cases.falsifying_observation: Only the spoken rewrite instruction is returned. A positive rewrite is not evidence of intent4 or authorization for whole-window replacement.
